players.detail: Head coach Todd Bowles said Monday that the Buccaneers "will try and lessen the load" on Irving following their Week 10 bye, Rick Stroud of the Tampa Bay Times reports.

players.name: Jalen McMillan
players.detail: Head coach Todd Bowles suggested Monday that McMillan (knee) isn't likely to immediately return to action following the Buccaneers' Week 10 bye, Rick Stroud of the Tampa Bay Times reports.

players.name: Chris Godwin Jr.
players.detail: Godwin caught two of three targets for 16 yards and added a 12-yard rush during Sunday night's 27-24 loss to the Bears.

players.name: Kenny Gainwell
players.detail: Gainwell rushed five times for 16 yards and caught all three of his targets for 60 yards in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Bears.

players.name: Baker Mayfield
players.detail: Mayfield completed 18 of 32 passes for 243 yards, no touchdowns and two interceptions in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Bears. He also rushed once for no gain and ran in a two-point conversion.

players.name: Emeka Egbuka
players.detail: Egbuka (foot) caught three of five targets for 38 yards and added a one-yard run in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Bears.

players.name: Bauer Sharp
players.detail: Sharp went without a target while playing 19 of the Buccaneers' 60 snaps on offense in Sunday's 16-0 win over the Falcons.

players.name: Tyjae Spears
players.detail: questionable

players.name: Carnell Tate
players.detail: questionable

players.name: Tony Pollard
players.detail: The Titans opted not to move Pollard ahead of Tuesday's trade deadline, despite him drawing interest from teams, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Nicholas Singleton
players.detail: Titans head coach Robert Saleh said Monday that Singleton is "getting better," and the rookie running back could be a candidate to see added opportunities in the second half of the season if lead back Tony Pollard is dealt ahead of Tuesday's deadline, Turron Davenport of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Calvin Ridley
players.detail: Titans head coach Robert Saleh confirmed Monday that Ridley was involved in an "unfortunate" interaction over the weekend at Nashville International Airport that is now in the hands of law enforcement, Cameron Wolfe of NFL Network reports.

players.name: Joey Slye
players.detail: Slye hit both field-goal tries and his two extra-point attempts in Sunday's 43-36 overtime loss to the Bengals.

players.name: Elic Ayomanor
players.detail: Ayomanor caught three of five targets for 34 yards in Sunday's 43-36 overtime loss to the Bengals.

players.name: Chimere Dike
players.detail: Dike caught five of six targets for 61 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 43-36 overtime loss to the Bengals.

players.name: Gunnar Helm
players.detail: Helm caught five of nine targets for 76 yards during Sunday's 43-36 overtime loss to the Bengals.

players.name: Wan'Dale Robinson
players.detail: Robinson caught six of seven targets for 57 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 43-36 overtime loss to the Bengals. He also lost a fumble.

players.name: Cam Ward
players.detail: Ward completed 26 of 40 passes for 304 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 43-36 overtime loss to the Bengals. He added seven rushing attempts for 41 yards, lost a fumble, ran in a two-point conversion and threw a successful two-point conversion.

players.name: Treylon Burks
players.detail: Burks (foot) doesn't have an injury designation for Thursday night's game against the Giants.

players.name: Colson Yankoff
players.detail: Commanders head coach Dan Quinn ruled out Yankoff (knee) for Thursday night's games against the Giants, Ben Standig of The Team 980 Washington D.C. reports.

players.name: Chig Okonkwo
players.detail: Okonkwo (hip) was a full participant in Tuesday's walkthrough practice.

players.name: Antonio Williams
players.detail: Williams caught three passes for 25 yards on six targets in Sunday's 20-13 loss to the Rams.

players.name: Drew Stevens
players.detail: Stevens made both of his field-goal attempts and his only PAT during Sunday's 20-13 loss to the Rams.

players.name: Austin Ekeler
players.detail: Ekeler rushed eight times for 16 yards and caught two of three targets for 18 yards during Sunday's 20-13 loss to the Rams.

players.name: Van Jefferson
players.detail: Jefferson caught five of seven targets for 58 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 20-13 loss to the Rams.

players.name: Stefon Diggs
players.detail: Diggs caught three of five targets for 51 yards in Sunday's 20-13 loss to the Rams.

players.name: Rachaad White
players.detail: White carried the ball seven times for 28 yards and caught two of three targets for 41 yards in Sunday's 20-13 loss to the Rams.

players.name: Jayden Daniels
players.detail: Daniels completed 24 of 35 passes for 274 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 20-13 loss to the Rams. He also gained 16 rushing yards on four carries and lost a fumble.

players.name: Dyami Brown
players.detail: The Commanders placed Brown (calf) on injured reserve Saturday.

players.name: Jeremy McNichols
players.detail: McNichols, who suffered a foot injury Sunday against the Eagles that may require surgery, is out for the season, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

players.name: Robert Henry Jr.
players.detail: The Commanders claimed Henry off waivers from the Seahawks on Tuesday.
